# apple_alternative_distribution_package_versions (Data Source)

Lists the versions of an alternative distribution package, with the URLs they download from. Apple adds a version after it builds the package; the earlier ones become `REPLACED`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_alternative_distribution_package_versions" "current" {
  package_id = apple_alternative_distribution_package.example.id
  states     = ["COMPLETED"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the package, e.g. `apple_alternative_distribution_package.example.id`.

### Optional

- `states` (Set of String) States to list. Values: `COMPLETED`, `REPLACED`.

### Read-Only

- `versions` (Attributes List) The versions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `file_checksum` (String) SHA-256 checksum of the package.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the package version.
- `state` (String) State of the version: `COMPLETED`, `REPLACED`.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) URL the package downloads from until `url_expiration_date`.
- `url_expiration_date` (String) When `url` stops working. Read the data source again for a new URL.
- `version` (String) Version of the package.
